title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset password from Settings > Security.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are allowed within 7 days of purchase.

title: Account Creation
content: New users can create an account by clicking the Sign Up button and providing email and password.

title: Payment Methods
content: We accept credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal for payments.

title: Shipping Information
content: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping takes 2-3 business days.

title: Customer Support Hours
content: Our customer support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST.

title: Product Warranty
content: All products come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects and malfunctions.

title: Return Policy
content: Items can be returned within 30 days of purchase in original condition with receipt.

title: Account Deletion
content: Users can delete their account from Settings > Privacy > Delete Account.

title: Technical Support
content: For technical issues, email support@example.com or use the live chat feature.
